review.en: A collection of essays gathered late in Zong Baihua's life, on Chinese painting, calligraphy, poetry and gardens, on space and rhythm, and on the meeting of Chinese and Western ideas of beauty. It wanders rather than argues, as its title promises, and its warmth and fine perceptions have made it a favourite way into Chinese aesthetics.
review.zh: 宗白华晚年结集的文章，谈中国的绘画、书法、诗与园林，谈空间意识与节奏，也谈中西美感的相遇。正如书名所说，它是漫步而不是论证，文字温润，感受细腻，成为许多人进入中国美学的心爱之书。
